import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import kit

# an entry with no parameters, void result, and no pipes
campaign = {"types": [{"name": "V", "kind": "void"}],
            "modules": [{"name": "m", "params": [], "result": ["r", "V"],
                         "requires": None}],
            "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"], "machine": None,
            "runs": [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode([])},
                     {"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode([])},
                     {"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode([("x0", b"\x00")])}]}
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print(out)
assert out["plans"][0]["slots"] == [] and out["plans"][0]["variables"] == 0
assert [r["status"] for r in out["records"]] == ["READY", "DUPLICATE", "INVALID_TEST"]
assert out["corpus"][0]["inputs"] == {} and out["corpus"][0]["witnesses"] == [0, 1]

# void result plus pipes still reserves the flag as x0
campaign = {"types": [{"name": "V", "kind": "void"}, {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}],
            "modules": [{"name": "m", "params": [], "result": ["r", "V"], "requires": None},
                        {"name": "f", "params": [], "result": ["r", "B"],
                         "requires": ["const", "B", False]}],
            "calls": [], "pipes": [{"target": "m", "filter": "f", "bind": {}}],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
_, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
print(plan)
assert plan["slots"] == [] and plan["flag"] == "x0" and plan["variables"] == 1
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode([("x0", b"\x00")])},
                    {"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode([("x0", b"\x01")])},
                    {"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode([])}]
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print(out["records"])
assert [r["status"] for r in out["records"]] == ["INVALID_TEST", "FILTERED", "INVALID_TEST"]

# strings with no NUL at all recover the whole buffer; String(0) is ""
campaign = {"types": [{"name": "S0", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 0},
                      {"name": "S3", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
                      {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}],
            "modules": [{"name": "m", "params": [["a", "S0"], ["b", "S3"]],
                         "result": ["r", "B"],
                         "requires": ["eq", ["var", "a"], ["const", "S0", ""]]}],
            "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
_, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
print(plan["slots"], plan["variables"])
assert [s[0] for s in plan["slots"]] == ["x2", "x3", "x4", "x6"]
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
    [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], [97, 98, 99, 0])])}]
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print(out["records"], out["corpus"])
assert out["corpus"][0]["inputs"] == {"a": "", "b": "abc"}
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "READY"

# Latin-1 payloads above 127 and NUL characters survive JSON framing
campaign = {"types": [{"name": "C", "kind": "char"}, {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}],
            "modules": [{"name": "m", "params": [["c", "C"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                         "requires": ["eq", ["var", "c"], ["const", "C", "\u00ff"]]}],
            "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
_, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
    [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], [255, 0])])},
    {"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
        [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], [254, 0])])}]
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print(out["records"], out["corpus"][0]["inputs"], out["corpus"][0]["model_result"])
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "READY" and out["records"][1]["status"] == "FILTERED"
assert out["corpus"][0]["inputs"] == {"c": "\u00ff"}
print("EDGE OK")
